The '''Yiuli Mountains''' were a mountain range located on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. They separated the [[Yiulimar Ice Fjords]] from [[Beija]].<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
